messages.author: 5117fd6c9c423ce1
messages.subject: upgrade Shiny server from 1.0.0 to 1.2.0 (or?) - issues?
parts:
Hello,

I would like to be able to better use configuration info as described here, more effectively:

http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/

But my server is currently 1.0.0.42.  I'd like to upgrade to the most recent server version, or whatever will allow me to use the above config. reference.  However, I need to minimize upgrade issues and also, I need to maintain running Shiny with R 3.0.1.   Should I be able to upgrade to the latest Shiny server (1.2.3) readily, or... ?

Thank you.

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: upgrade Shiny server from 1.0.0 to 1.2.0 (or?) - issues?
parts:
Hi Cyndy,

Are you using any Rmd files? The newest version of Shiny Server supports Rmd processing, and therefore a change in behavior. If that is the case, tell us what your use case is.

Otherwise, the upgrade from 1.0.0.42 to the latest version is very easy and takes less than 1 minute; affecting your applications very briefly (you need to refresh your browser pages after new install). As far as we know, you shouldn't expect any problems with the latest version. But for a worst case scenario, have your old version installer handy. If you notice an immediate problem with the latest version, you can quickly uninstall this (let us know of the problem), and install the old version (hopefully you wouldn't need to do this). 

Regards,
Fereshteh
